name: remote-hotkey-emulator
description: Control Windows emulator shortcuts from a phone over a trusted local network.

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:web && node --test dist/server/*.test.js dist/desktop/*.test.js scripts/web.test.mjs
scripts.build:desktop: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:web && tsc -p tsconfig.desktop-ui.json && node scripts/build-desktop.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.desktop-ui.json --noEmit
